description: ODYSSEY is an interactive space mission simulation game where players step into the role of space engineers. Learn about rockets, choose missions, design spacecraft, manage limited government funding, make engineering decisions and experience simulated launches and space exploration. Inspired by missions from ISRO, NASA, ESA and other space agencies, ODYSSEY makes space exploration an engaging, hands-on learning experience.
summary: SPACE ODYSSEY is an educational Space Mission Design Game developed for students of all age groups. It features a beginner mode with simple gameplay and voice assistance, and an advanced mode with interactive mission planning, hologram-based 3D visualizations and realistic rocket launches. It addresses the challenge by making complex space mission concepts easy to understand through hands-on simulation. It encourages curiosity, creativity and practical learning about space exploration and technology.
details:
• Purpose: An interactive Space Mission Design Game for students of all age groups.
    • Beginner Mode: Easy gameplay with voice assistance.
    • Advanced Mode: Interactive mission planning, hologram-based 3D visualizations, spacecraft selection and rocket launch simulations.
  • Benefits: Makes complex space concepts easier and more enjoyable to learn.
  • Impact: Encourages scientific curiosity, creativity, problem-solving and interest in space exploration.
  • Technology Used: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Three.js, MediaPipe and Web Speech API.
  • Creativity: Combines voice interaction, hologram-style visuals and realistic mission experiences.
  • Design Considerations: Age suitability, accessibility, ease of use and educational value.
